must_mention_risks.text: SES has no first-party Google Cloud equivalent; a third-party email provider or SMTP relay is needed
The priority-queue pattern uses separate SQS queues with dead-letter queues; Pub/Sub has no native priority, so use separate topics and subscriptions
S3 event notifications to Lambda must be rebuilt as Cloud Storage notifications to Pub/Sub or a Cloud Run trigger
Infrastructure is written with AWS CDK (Python) and cannot be reused; it must be rewritten (for example in Terraform)
SES sender verification and deliverability reputation must be rebuilt with the new provider
